# FLX-7007: prediction id is already registered with a different seal

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A sealed prediction is written once. `fluxsim accuracy register` never replaces a registered record, because a claim that can be swapped after its outcome is known is not a prediction. A record is already registered under this prediction_id, and the submitted document seals to a different digest; the refusal names the record and both digests. Nothing was written, and the registered record is as it was. When the registered record carries another inputDigest, it was made from another bundle, and the refusal says so and names the first 16 hex digits of both; give the item its own id in one of the bundles. Register a different claim under a new prediction_id. Registering the same claim again (a document that seals to the same digest) is not refused: it succeeds and writes nothing.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7007
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
